# Ultimate Esthetics

> Ultimate Esthetics is a skin, hair and body aesthetic clinic in Rawalpindi, Pakistan.

## Official website
- https://ultimate-esthetics-demo.pages.dev/

## Location and contact
- Address: Al-ain Arcade, Old Airport Road, Rawalpindi 46000, Pakistan
- Phone: +92 334 0005909
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/ultimateesthetics1
- Opening hours listed on the website: Monday to Saturday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

## Services listed on the website
- Hair transplant
- Hair PRP
- Hair exosomes
- PRGF
- Hydrafacial
- PRP and microneedling
- Dermapen microneedling
- Acne and scar treatment
- Laser treatment
- Skin brightening
- Glow drip

## Booking
Visitors can request a consultation through the booking form on the official website. Appointment requests are subject to clinic confirmation.

## Notes
- Service availability, pricing, and suitability should be confirmed directly with the clinic.
- This file is informational and is not medical advice.
